caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a metal trivet with a handle, rendered primarily in shades of black and gray on a beige background. The central object is a three-dimensional perspective view of the trivet, showcasing its triangular iron frame, ornate scrollwork within the frame, and a turned cylindrical handle attached at one end. The trivet's surface is composed of interwoven, curved bars forming a symmetrical pattern with pointed ends. Along the top left of the drawing, two additional line drawings present the trivet from a top and a side elevation view, both displaying the same scrollwork and frame shape. To the left of the trivet, beneath the elevation drawings, a small linear scale is included. The drawing is enclosed within a single rectangular border, and there is a signature or notation in cursive at the bottom left corner. The entire composition is executed in monochrome graphite or ink, with no added coloration.
title: Pa. German Flat-iron Stand
